summary: Materialise NV filed a Form 6-K reporting weekly progress on its share buyback program announced October 30, 2025. Under the program, an independent intermediary is authorized to repurchase up to EUR 30 million of Materialise shares. During the May 25-29, 2026 week, 8,706 shares were repurchased on NASDAQ at an average price of EUR 5.22, for total consideration of EUR 45,444. Since the program started January 26, 2026, the company has bought back 808,122 shares (1.4% of outstanding) for EUR 3.69 million. The program is an ongoing open-market repurchase, not a tender offer. Watch for the pace of repurchases and any acceleration or completion announcement.
